data.name: Tale's Edge
data.detailed_description:
Survive an ancient, unforgiving world based on the original dark fairy tales of the Brother’s Grimm. Outmatched and alone, your wits become your greatest ally.

You play as Red Riding Hood, 8 years after her original tale, raised by the Huntsman who cut her from the wolf. When he leaves one morning and does not return, Red sets out on an epic journey to find him.

Discover an incredible cast of characters, villains, and creatures where factions shift, NPCs remember, and events unfold with or without you. How you play, interact, and survive encounters changes their behaviors. Some may be grateful. Others may seek revenge.

Whether you choose to end the lives of defeated enemies or spare them, it shapes who Red becomes and how her character plays. Players who fight with honor will grow to become a dangerous hero, while players who kill mercilessly will literally watch Red’s attacks and behaviors become more violent and savage as she descends into darkness.

Explore a dense world with metroidvania-like exploration, rich stories, and immersive environments that reward player curiosity. Branching narratives with multiple solutions create new challenges based on how you choose to play.

Customize your gear, abilities, and evolve your playstyle through a unique progression system. Whether you favor stealth, combat, or crafting, every build influences Red’s path.

Early in the game, Red receives a mysterious amulet from the Fairy Godmother to protect her from lethal damage. As you progress, the amulet reveals new abilities. Connect threads between characters and objects to influence their actions. Imbue your weapons and items, and use thread tethers to unlock unique traversal.

The world will test you. Consequences will reveal you.

data.short_description: Tale's Edge is a dark fairytale action-RPG set in a shared world of fables from the Brothers Grimm. You play as Red Riding Hood 8 years after her tale, searching for the Huntsman who raised her. Every choice shapes who you become, and the world learns from how you play.
